shared_elements: low-relief carved rounded forms filling the whole field
stylised face-like element with round eye sockets
justification: Both surfaces carry densely packed schematic relief in rounded, blunt raised outlines, and both include curled volute forms and a mask-like face with hollow round eyes, which is the most specific point of contact. But A shows recognisable bodied figures with arms, hands and torsos arranged in a horizontal frieze-like scene, whereas B is a vertical field of interlocking abstract, glyph-like scroll units with no bodies or limbs, so the actual subject matter and its organisation differ substantially.
